author: Martens, Eck, Päckert, Sun, 1999
summary: 중국 중부(쓰촨·후베이·산시 등)의 산지에서 번식하고 동남아시아에서 겨울을 나는 솔새로, 우리나라에서는 2021년 5월 8–9일 백령도에서 처음 기록되었고 2022년 5월 같은 곳에서 두 번째로 기록된 길잃은새다. 숲 아래층의 덤불 속을 낮게 옮겨 다니며 짧게 날아올라 곤충을 잡는다. 눈 둘레에 노란 테가 있는 회색머리노랑솔새 등과 생김새가 매우 비슷해, 가늘고 짧은 한 음절 울음소리로 가려낸다.

art.subject: Martens's Warbler (Phylloscopus omeiensis), adult (sexes alike), a vagrant on a Korean offshore island in May: crown centre grey with at most a faint greenish tinge, bordered on each side by a black lateral crown stripe from above the eye to the nape; a yellow eye-ring; cheeks yellowish-green; upperparts olive-green; wings and tail olive-green with darker centres, sometimes with a faint, narrow pale wing-bar on the greater coverts; some white on the inner webs of the outer tail feathers; entire underparts bright yellow. Broad-based bill, dark above with a pale orange lower mandible; dark eye; pale yellowish legs.
art.pose: perched on a thin twig in the understorey, side view, alert
art.scene: deciduous woodland on a Korean offshore island in May with fresh green leaves and dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a thin twig: grey crown centre with a faint green tinge between black lateral crown stripes, yellow eye-ring, olive-green upperparts, faint narrow pale wing-bar, entirely bright yellow underparts, bill dark above and pale orange below, pale legs

adult, head close-up in side view: grey central crown stripe, black lateral crown stripe running from above the eye to the nape, yellow eye-ring, yellowish-green cheeks, broad-based bill with rictal bristles
adult, perched with the tail slightly spread, seen from below: olive tail with white on the inner webs of the outer feathers, bright yellow underparts and undertail coverts
art.build: A small, compact, round-headed warbler, smaller than a sparrow and about the size of a Japanese White-eye, with a fairly broad, flat-based bill and noticeable rictal bristles. Bill shorter than the head. Legs slender and pale. Wings short and rounded, the wingtips reaching only a short way down the tail. Tail medium length and square-ended. Moves actively through the forest understorey and lower canopy.
art.basis: 형태: 국내외 종 설명 교차 확인(출처 목록) · tools/ART_RULES.md
avoid: Do not paint a green crown centre; that is Green-crowned Warbler (Phylloscopus burkii).
Do not paint a broad, bold pale wing-bar (Bianchi's Warbler, Phylloscopus valentini); any wing-bar here is faint and narrow.
Do not add a supercilium or a dark eye-stripe; the face shows only the yellow eye-ring below the black crown stripes.
Do not paint a whitish belly; the underparts are yellow throughout.
